en: Salutations to Śrī Gaṇeśa.
Indra said:
Salutations to you, O Mahāmāyā, who are worshipped by the gods upon the venerable seat (Śrīpīṭha).
O Mahālakṣmī, who holds the conch, the discus, and the mace in your hands, salutations be to you! || 1 ||
Salutations to you, O Goddess mounted upon Garuḍa, who strikes fear into the demon Kolāsura;
O Goddess Mahālakṣmī, remover of all sins, salutations be to you! (2)
O Omniscient One, O Bestower of all boons, O Terrifier of all the wicked, O Goddess who removes all suffering—homage be to you, Mahālakṣmī! || 3 ||
O Goddess who bestows accomplishment and wisdom, who grants both worldly enjoyment and liberation;
O Goddess whose very form is mantra, O Mahālakṣmī, salutations always unto you! (4)
O Goddess, devoid of beginning and end, primordial power, Great Sovereign;
O Knower of Yoga, born of Yoga, Mahālakṣmī, salutations be to you! (5)
O Goddess, who art gross, subtle, and most fierce; O Mahāśakti, O Mahodara; O Goddess, destroyer of great sins; salutations to you, Mahālakṣmī! || 6 ||
O Goddess seated in the lotus posture, whose nature is the Supreme Brahman;
O Supreme Mistress, Mother of the World, Mahālakṣmī, salutations be unto you! (7)
O Goddess clad in white garments, adorned with various ornaments, who dwells within the world, O Mother of the World, Mahālakṣmī, salutations be to you! || 8 ||
The man who, full of devotion, recites this hymn of eight verses to Mahālakṣmī, which proclaims its fruits,
attains all perfections and always obtains sovereignty.
One who recites this daily at one time destroys great sins;
he who recites it daily at two times shall be endowed with wealth and grain. || 2 ||
Whoever constantly recites this daily, which destroys the great enemy,
for him there shall always be Great Fortune— gracious, auspicious, and bestowing boons.
